title: The Person
Behind the Code
about.bio1: I build AI/ML systems that run in production — retrieval-augmented generation, LLM integration, edge machine learning, and time-series forecasting. I focus on the parts that make a system trustworthy: grounding, latency, evaluation, and failure modes.
about.bio2: I document my work in public, publishing build notes and project write-ups on this site every week. Before that, 4+ years as a software and systems engineer at Infosys and Novigo, building regulated banking and healthcare platforms. Currently completing an MEng in Business Intelligence & Data Analytics at Hochschule Emden/Leer.

items.subtitle: Retrieval-Augmented Chat Assistant
items.description: A retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions about my work. Hybrid retrieval over an embedded knowledge base, a grounding layer that keeps answers tied to sources, and a semantic cache that cuts repeat-query latency from seconds to milliseconds. Runs on edge workers at near-zero cost.

items.subtitle: LSTM & ARIMA Forecasting
items.description: Engineered LSTM and ARIMA models to forecast NIFTY 50 Open and Close prices with MAPE below 3%. Built reproducible data pipelines, walk-forward validation, automated forecasting workflows, and a Streamlit dashboard with CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

items.subtitle: Edge AI on a Microcontroller
items.description: End-to-end TinyML person recognition: OpenCV preprocessing, a CNN trained in TensorFlow/Keras, INT8 quantization, and deployment to TensorFlow Lite Micro on an Arduino-class board. Cosine-similarity thresholding rejects unknown faces; quantization cuts model size by roughly 95%.

items.subtitle: MQTT IoT Messaging Platform
items.description: An IoT communication platform built around the MQTT protocol — devices publish and subscribe to topics in real time, enabling instant signal exchange across distributed nodes. Containerized with Docker Compose.

items.subtitle: Computer-Vision Inventory Scanner
items.description: A barcode scanning application with inventory management. Supports multiple barcode formats via OpenCV and ZBar, real-time lookups, and data export for warehouse and retail workflows.

items.subtitle: Data Science Notebooks
items.description: Collection of Python notebooks covering statistical analysis, data cleaning, feature engineering, visualization, and exploratory data analysis across real-world datasets.
